purpose: External benchmark hold-out of macro P/C without gold leakage into candidate production or P-internal adjudication.

generation.P: L1,L2,L3_raw,L3_informed plus gold-free structural anti-regression selector
generation.C: same baseline seed with TALM v0.5.2 mass_right_soft

allowed_features: ARC final label belongs to presented choice labels
anti_regression.rule: retain L3_informed if structurally nondominated; if dominated and multiple parseable frontier stages remain, abstain rather than synthesize

temporal_firewall: question text and answer format are visible during generation
gold answer is not passed to P, C, or A_P
P/C/baseline candidate hashes and BASELINE macro decision are frozen before gold evaluation
gold is evaluated only after decision freeze

outcome.WTL: WIN if candidate correct and baseline incorrect; LOSS if candidate incorrect and baseline correct; TIE otherwise

dataset_transportability.criterion: each dataset has >=6 admissible observations and observed LOSS <= WIN

gates.authority: No operational authority is granted by v1.3.

claim_boundary: Benchmark items are externally sourced but may have existed in model pretraining; this is not contamination-free evaluation.
Indices are frozen before execution; item content and hashes are preserved in the artifact.
No gold leakage into A_P is permitted.
This is one-model external validation; cross-model evidence comes from the separately preregistered v1.2 gate.
